tickets.title: Prepare month-by-month tuition schedule
tickets.text: Prepare a month-by-month schedule showing how much of Marzipan Meadow charges can be covered by Elin’s 529, the Teacup Comet tuition set-aside, and the Paper Otter Treasury fund without changing retirement contributions for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that schedule by December 19, 2023.

tickets.title: Obtain itemized billing packet
tickets.text: Obtain the itemized student account PDF billing packet for Marzipan Meadow College to substantiate the payment plan and qualified expense categories for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to obtain the itemized billing packet by December 12, 2023.

tickets.title: Resolve 529 balance mismatch
tickets.text: Resolve the balance mismatch for Elin’s 529 account, where Mira reported a screenshot of $67,400 but the statement showed $72,270, for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to resolve the balance mismatch by December 15, 2023.

tickets.title: Identify payment or reimbursement workflow
tickets.text: Identify an acceptable direct payment or reimbursement workflow for the college portal that rejected the bank verification for a 529 payment for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to identify the payment or reimbursement workflow by December 18, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare Rowan education funding projection
tickets.text: Prepare a separate education funding projection for Rowan Quillwhistle using the existing 529 balance, expected test and application costs, and a first‑year college savings target that does not rely on borrowing.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by December 29, 2023.

tickets.title: Prepare cost‑gap estimate for Rowan
tickets.text: Prepare a cost‑gap estimate for Rowan Quillwhistle to compare merit aid offers before the first school deposit decision, based on the scholarship and aid timing calendar.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the cost-gap estimate by February 2, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare off‑campus housing projection
tickets.text: Prepare a projection of rent, food, and utility amounts for Elin Quillwhistle’s off‑campus apartment option and assess how they fit into the education funding plan versus parent cash flow.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare that projection by January 19, 2024.

tickets.title: Prepare sale‑sequencing and tax estimate
tickets.text: Prepare a sale‑sequencing plan and tax estimate for using the Paper Otter taxable account’s education reserve, considering unrealized gains in the equity index fund and Treasury position for Mira Quillwhistle.
tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the sale-sequencing and tax estimate by January 3, 2024.
